deadline.value: Apply by 11:59pm Pacific, December 1, 2026 for Autumn 2027; no late applications.
deadline.quote: The application deadline for admission to Autumn 2027 is Tuesday, December 1, 2026 at 11:59pm Pacific Time.

gre_subject.value: The GRE Mathematics Subject Test is expected; if taking it is not practical you can submit a waiver form explaining why.
gre_subject.quote: Applicants are expected to submit their GRE Mathematics Subject Test score. | If it is not practical for you to take the GRE Mathematics Subject Test you will be able to submit a waiver form as part of your application.

gre_general.value: GRE General scores are neither required nor accepted.
gre_general.quote: GRE General Test Scores are neither required nor accepted as part of the application.

supervisor.value: The admissions page does not mention contacting a supervisor before applying.

funding.value: PhD students making satisfactory progress are fully funded for five years (fellowships, TA and RA positions).
funding.quote: Students in the PhD program who make satisfactory progress are fully funded for five years.

entry_route.value: A bachelor's degree (or international equivalent) is enough; a master's is not needed.
entry_route.quote: Applicants from institutions outside the U.S. must hold the equivalent of a U.S. bachelor’s degree from a college or university of recognized standing.

notes: The Math Department cannot give fee waivers itself; use the university's school-based waivers. No external MS admission.
